content: उच्चाटनम् .²1 Driving away, expulsion, removal from a place; उच्चाटनं त्वमपि लम्भयसे तदेव <ls>Kuval.</ls> .²2 Separation. .²3 Eradication; तापत्रयोच्चाटनम् <ls>Viś. Guṇā. 533</ls>; extirpation (of a plant). .²4 A kind of charm or magical incantation. .²5 Working this charm, ruining oneʼs enemy, making a person leave his business by magical spells by making him disgusted with it. .{@-नः@} <ab>N.</ab> of one of the five arrows of Kāma.
